answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.749, near the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and well above quantized or fine-tuned. KL 0.304, top-1 agreement 0.875 and Token-DiFR gap 0.505 all sit in the system-prompted range. The layer-2 spike of 61.9 is decisive, since fine-tuned and quantized models stay at 6.1 or below. Onset layer 8, layer-16 relative L2 of 0.479, final cosine 0.847, effective rank 2.81, direction consistency 0.538 and activation-to-logit ratio 1.7 all match system-prompted too. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the divergence at token 0, the huge layer-2 spike and the mid-layer size ratio of 0.971 (below 1 rather than growing). Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and the strong early divergence.
